component.name: openMSX
component.summary: Emulate all aspects of the MSX with high accuracy

description.p: openMSX is an emulator for the MSX home computer system. MSX was a standard for Z80-based home computers, and was a (largely) Japanese attempt to establish a single standard in home computing similar to VHS in video.
The MSX standard was designed by ASCII Corporation in Japan, in cooperation with Microsoft Japan. The latter of which provided the extended BASIC for the machine.

In addition to emulating MSX, MSX2, MSX2+, MSX turbo R and many of its peripherals, openMSX also supports emulating the ColecoVision and Sega SG-1000 game consoles and the SpectraVideo SVI-318 and SVI-328 home computer systems.

Note: by default the openMSX emulator only ships with the C-BIOS open-source BIOS implementation. This BIOS is restricted to cartridge based MSX games. For a full MSX or SVI emulation it is necessary to provide your own MSX and/or SVI BIOS ROMs, which must be placed in the ~/.openMSX/share/systemroms directory.
